
{{alias}}( d, y, p )
    Computes the Huber loss.

    If any argument is `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    d: number
        Threshold.

    y: number
        True target value.

    p: number
        Predicted value.

    Returns
    -------
    v: number
        Huber loss.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 5.0, 10.2, 0.782 )
    34.59
    > v = {{alias}}( 2.0, 8.0, 0.202 )
    13.596
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, 23.2, -0.999 )
    23.699
    > v = {{alias}}( 11.0, -12.2, 0.234 )
    76.274
    > v = {{alias}}( 2.0, -21.0, 0.2 )
    40.4
    > v = {{alias}}( 9.0, 4.0, -0.9 )
    12.005
    > v = {{alias}}( NaN, 1.0, 0.987 )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
